channel.title: 2026-07 on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in 2026-07 on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Single-click purchase for public SaaS offers
item.description:
Eligible SaaS products in Microsoft Marketplace now support a single-page purchase flow in the Azure portal. Buyers can review plan, billing, resource group, contact details, and terms before completing the purchase.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Upcoming August 2026 model deprecations in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot will deprecate several models across all Copilot experiences on September 1, 2026. The affected experiences include Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: CaptiveCrunch: Midnight Blizzard targets travelers worldwide for malware delivery and credential theft
item.description:
Microsoft says Storm-2945, a sub-cluster of Midnight Blizzard, has been compromising sign-in portals at hospitality organizations since May 2026 to deliver malware to travelers and steal credentials. The campaign is named CaptiveCrunch and targets travelers worldwide.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Route-Maps for Azure Route Server
item.description:
Route maps for Azure Route Server are in public preview. They let customers control inbound and outbound routing on hybrid connections by managing routes advertised to and from Azure Route Server BGP peerings.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash deprecated
item.description:
GitHub has deprecated Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash across all Copilot experiences as of July 31, 2026. This includes Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-July
item.description:
Azure SQL added a public preview of regex-based dynamic data masking. It extends built-in DDM with pattern-based masking for sensitive data such as emails, phone numbers, and identifiers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Enterprise teams model policy targeting in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has added user-based model policy targeting for enterprise teams in public preview. It is available to GitHub Enterprise customers with Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise licenses and lets AI administrators set a baseline policy.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Restricting npm bypass-2FA granular access tokens
item.description:
npm granular access tokens configured to bypass 2FA can no longer be used for sensitive account, organization, and package management actions. Those operations now require an interactive 2FA challenge.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37 Sneak Peek
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 is planning several deprecations and a few feature graduations. Notable changes include deprecating kubectl run -f, forbidding Static Pods from referencing Secrets/ConfigMaps, starting deprecation of kube-proxy ipvs mode, and moving SELinuxMount to GA with possible workload impact.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: dotnet: From generated code to trusted code with a unit-test agent
item.description:
Microsoft introduced an open-source polyglot unit-testing agent that analyzes a repository, generates unit tests, and verifies that the tests build and pass. The post focuses on moving from generated code to code that is checked and trusted through automated testing.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: devops+ai: Had baby, Back September!
item.description:
The post says the author had a baby in September and will be back later. They also note they won’t be using AI for a while.

  • Source: Let’s do DevOps

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in India South Central
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server is now generally available in the India South Central Azure region. Users can deploy new flexible server instances in that region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Models is now retired
item.description:
GitHub Models was retired on July 30, 2026. The playground, model catalog, inference API, and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) access are no longer available to customers.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Automation supports PowerShell 7.6 runbooks and Runtime environment
item.description:
Azure Automation now generally supports PowerShell 7.6 runbooks and the Runtime environment. This lets customers move scripts to a supported runtime version, with Azure CLI command support also mentioned in the update.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Reservation exchanges for Azure services supported by savings plans will no longer be available starting February 1, 2027
item.description:
Azure will stop allowing reservation exchanges for services covered by savings plans starting February 1, 2027. At announcement time, this applies to Azure Virtual Machine compute reservations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Symmetric keys on Azure Key Vault Premium
item.description:
Azure Key Vault Premium now supports symmetric keys in public preview. The preview lets customers and partners evaluate symmetric encryption using oct-HSM keys and AES.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Reference same-repository actions with self-repository syntax
item.description:
GitHub added a new self-repository syntax for uses: so actions and reusable workflows in the same repository can be referenced with a $/-prefixed value. This changes how same-repo workflows/actions are addressed, but the provided text does not include further details.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Support for SMB Opportunistic Locking (Oplocks) configuration
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files public preview adds configurable SMB opportunistic locking (oplocks) for SMB and dual-protocol volumes. Oplocks remain enabled by default and can be set on new volumes or updated on existing ones.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Stacked pull requests are now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has put stacked pull requests into public preview. The feature lets users split a larger change into an ordered series of smaller, reviewable pull requests.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: ​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: July 2026
item.description:
Microsoft’s July 2026 Security update highlights new capabilities for securing AI environments, using AI for defense, and improving the underlying systems that AI-powered operations rely on. The provided excerpt does not include specific product changes or feature details.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — July update
item.description:
GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio’s July 2026 update adds a new agent built on the Copilot SDK, plus built-in expertise from the .NET and Azure teams. It also adds more options to tailor Copilot to individual workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Limit remote control to managed devices
item.description:
Enterprises and organizations can now limit Copilot remote control sessions to managed devices. This adds administrator control over which devices are eligible to host remote control access.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, July 2026 releases
item.description:
GitHub’s July 2026 Copilot-in-VS Code changelog covers VS Code v1.127 through v1.131. The releases focus on agent workflows, reviewing changes, chat, and navigation improvements.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Agent skills and MCP now generally available
item.description:
Copilot code review now generally supports agent skills and MCP servers for all Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise users. These features have moved from public preview to general availability.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Monitor Logs mirroring into Microsoft Fabric
item.description:
Azure Monitor Logs can now be mirrored from Log Analytics workspaces into Microsoft Fabric in public preview. The telemetry is available in OneLake as Delta Parquet with near real-time availability and no data duplication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Sphere OS version 26.09 is now available for evaluation
item.description:
Azure Sphere OS version 26.09 RC1 is available in the Retail Eval feed for evaluation. This release has no customer-facing changes, but it includes a major upgrade to the underlying Linux kernel version as part of long-term support work.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: How the controller-runtime Cache Actually Works, and Why Your Controller Does Not Crash the API Server
item.description:
The article explains that controller-runtime controllers read from a local informer cache, not directly from the API server, and that writes go to the API server while the cache catches up asynchronously via watch events. It also details how shared informers, DeltaFIFO, indexing, cache scoping, APIReader, and cache disabling affect consistency, memory use, and query behavior.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: commandline: Tool search: Finding the right tool at the right time
item.description:
The article says the value in adding more tools to AI agents comes from surfacing the right tool at the right time, instead of exposing every tool upfront. It focuses on discoverability as the key problem.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: security: ​​Better security starts with better questions
item.description:
Microsoft Security says stronger security decisions come from asking better questions, using trusted AI, and combining AI outputs with human judgment. The post frames this as a way to help leaders make more confident decisions and build more resilient systems.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: Default model enablement for Copilot Business and Enterprise
item.description:
GitHub is introducing a global default enablement policy for generally available Copilot models on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans. New GA models will be enabled by default instead of requiring admins to turn each one on manually.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.1 improves analysis accuracy and framework coverage
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.1 has been released with improvements to analysis accuracy and broader framework coverage, including Go. The changelog item is brief and does not list additional specific fixes or language/framework details.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app usage metrics now expand across report rollups
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app usage metrics are now included in more of the Copilot usage metrics API. Individual app activity is now attributed to users in the enterprise-user and organization-user reports.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: npm publish-time malware scanning and dual-use metadata
item.description:
npm is adding automatic malware scanning when packages are published, along with a new metadata requirement for packages that may be used for both benign and malicious purposes. The changelog says this is part of ongoing supply-chain security work and explains what publishers should expect.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: dotnet: Announcing v2.0 of the official MCP C# SDK
item.description:
The official MCP C# SDK v2.0 now implements the 2026-07-28 MCP specification. It adds a stateless-first protocol, standardized HTTP headers, and Multi Round-Trip Requests for interactive tools while remaining backward compatible.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: Grok 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Grok 4.5 is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says the xAI model is intended for fast, agentic coding and complex multi-step workflows, with a large context window.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Enclave
item.description:
Azure Enclave is now in public preview for Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. It is intended to simplify deployment and management of isolated cloud environments for sensitive workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: NAT64 on StandardV2 NAT Gateway
item.description:
StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports NAT64. This lets IPv6 workloads reach IPv4-only internet destinations by translating synthesized outbound IPv6 traffic to IPv4, using a DNS64-capable resolver.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Application Routing with Gateway API
item.description:
Application Routing with Gateway API is now generally available on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). It lets teams use the Kubernetes Gateway API for ingress routing while supporting existing deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Resource placement in Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager
item.description:
Resource placement in Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager is now generally available. It lets users define where Kubernetes resources should be scheduled across multiple clusters to reduce manual work and improve consistency.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Maximum allowed failures for update runs in Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager
item.description:
Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager now has a preview option to set a maximum number of allowed failures for update runs. In fail-fast rollouts, this lets some member cluster update failures occur without stopping the broader deployment immediately.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification
item.description:
Azure announces a public preview of Prepared Image Specification for AKS workloads that need faster node startup. The feature is aimed at reducing delays caused by repeated container image downloads and initialization on new nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Azure now available from new cloud region in India (India South Central)
item.description:
Microsoft has launched a new Azure datacenter region in India, India South Central, with campuses in Hyderabad, Telangana. The region is intended to provide local cloud infrastructure for customers in India.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Dependabot alerts on malicious packages across more ecosystems
item.description:
GitHub Advisory Database now ingests malware advisories from OpenSSF’s malicious-packages repository, expanding the malware data available to Dependabot alerts. This broadens coverage across more ecosystems.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Actions holds potentially malicious workflows for approval
item.description:
GitHub Actions now detects potentially malicious workflow changes in public repositories and requires approval before they run. The change is intended to reduce supply-chain abuse from compromised credentials used to add workflows that steal CI/CD secrets or perform follow-on attacks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now includes improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management. The update also adds support for connecting MCP servers and custom agents in Claude agent flows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Manage GitHub Copilot app access with a dedicated policy
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now has a dedicated policy for controlling app access at both the enterprise and organization levels. This separates Copilot app access from the previous broader access controls.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Claude Opus 5 on Azure Databricks
item.description:
Azure Databricks now supports Anthropic Claude Opus 5 through AI Model Serving. The update makes the model available for advanced reasoning, coding, agentic workflows, and professional knowledge work.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Enterprise managed settings in the GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent now support enterprise managed settings, letting organizations apply the same centrally managed Copilot policies across the enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: dotnet: Analyze MSBuild Binary Logs with Copilot in VS Code
item.description:
Microsoft introduced the MSBuild Binlog Analyzer for VS Code, a Copilot-powered tool for reading MSBuild binary logs, explaining build failures, suggesting fixes, comparing builds, and identifying regressions. It uses the Microsoft.AITools.BinlogMcp MCP server.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: HTTP header insertion in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall now supports inserting or overwriting HTTP/HTTPS request headers from application rules. This lets organizations enforce security controls and support tenant restriction at the firewall layer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Gateway in Azure API Management
item.description:
Azure API Management now has an AI Gateway tier in public preview. It is a dedicated tier designed for AI workloads, extending AI gateway capabilities already available in other API Management tiers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Rethinking security for the age of AI
item.description:
Microsoft says cybersecurity is changing in the AI era and introduces a new security cyber stack called Project Perception. The post frames this as a rethink of security architecture rather than a specific product release.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Enhancing AI security through global AI red teaming
item.description:
Microsoft announced EXTRA, a global AI security initiative focused on AI safety research and red teaming. The program partners with universities, researchers, and regional experts to identify emerging AI risks and improve testing of frontier AI systems.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: commandline: From research to reality: An interview with Microsoft VP of Security Research Taesoo Kim
item.description:
Microsoft interviewed Taesoo Kim, VP of Security Research and head of Security FORGE Labs, about codename MDASH and the lab’s work on security research. The interview highlights a multi-model, agentic approach as a potential direction for improving security capabilities.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: aks: Release 2026-07-17
item.description:
AKS v20260717 adds Artifact Streaming GA, new preview networking and scheduling features, and multiple behavior changes and bug fixes. It also updates Kubernetes patch versions, core add-ons, node images, and includes several retirement notices and upcoming defaults.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: github: Claude Opus 5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports Claude Opus 5, Anthropic’s latest Opus model. GitHub says it is intended for complex, long-running coding tasks that need careful reasoning and tool use.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub says Copilot cloud agent is now generally available for Linear. Users can assign Linear issues to the agent, which then analyzes the issue contents and works asynchronously in the background.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub MCP Server supports the next MCP specification
item.description:
GitHub MCP Server will support the upcoming MCP spec ahead of its official release. The key protocol change is a move to a stateless core on 28 July 2026.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Mobile: Fix failing Actions checks with Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Mobile now lets you ask Copilot coding agent to investigate and fix failing GitHub Actions checks on a pull request directly from the mobile app. The feature starts from a failed check and uses Copilot cloud agent to work on the issue.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Multi-select fields for Projects and Issues in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Projects and Issue fields now support multi-select fields in public preview, allowing a single field to store multiple values. This lets you tag an item with all relevant labels or categories instead of choosing just one.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is in public preview. It lets customers set per-resource DDoS mitigation thresholds for protected Standard Load Balancer frontend IP configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Agent automation controls in GitHub Issues in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Issues now exposes the reason behind agent-driven changes and lets users review proposed automation actions before they are applied. The feature is in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: Email threat landscape: Q2 2026 trends and insights
item.description:
Microsoft reports that Q2 2026 saw continued declines in several phishing techniques after disruption of the Tycoon2FA platform. Attackers shifted toward Teams-based social engineering and more automated, multi-stage attack chains.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Standard service endpoint is in public preview. It provides a more scalable and secure way to connect IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services within the Private Link family, addressing scale and management limits of earlier approaches.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: New Copilot usage metrics impact dashboard
item.description:
GitHub released a new Copilot metrics impact dashboard for enterprise administrators and organization owners. It is meant to help them report Copilot impact using usage metrics and related data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: Real world incident response: Microsoft and AXA XL strengthen cyber resilience
item.description:
Microsoft and AXA XL are collaborating to give cyber insurance policyholders direct access to Microsoft Incident Response services. The goal is to help organizations coordinate technical response, business decisions, and insurance actions during incidents.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: Upcoming GHES change impacting uploading support bundles
item.description:
GitHub will begin rejecting some GHES support bundle uploads starting August 18, 2026 because of an upcoming security change. Administrators should review the new upload requirements before that date to avoid failed submissions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: Building Agents that Act on Your Behalf with Toolboxes in Foundry
item.description:
Toolboxes in Microsoft Foundry are presented as a way to let agents act on a user’s behalf while handling delegated identity across tools and services. The post highlights using a private Entra-protected MCP server alongside Microsoft’s managed Work IQ MCP server in the same agent flow.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: github: Gemini 3.6 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is rolling out Gemini 3.6 Flash, Google’s latest Flash model. GitHub says it is intended for web and app development, coding, and longer-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable behavior.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI credit pools for cost centers in the billing UI
item.description:
GitHub Billing UI now lets you manage a cost center’s AI credit pool directly when creating or editing cost centers. Before this change, that configuration was only available through another interface.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot users can now see AI credits used per billing cycle
item.description:
Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise users can now view how many AI credits they have used in the current billing cycle, even if they do not have an individual budget. The usage count is available in GitHub Copilot usage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Protect sensitive generative AI telemetry in Application Insights and Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Application Insights now stores generative AI content in a dedicated GenAIContent table (AppGenAIContent in Log Analytics), enabling access controls for sensitive AI telemetry. The update is in public preview.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: IPv6 support for Azure VPN Gateway
item.description:
Azure VPN Gateway now supports IPv6 inner traffic in dual-stack VPN tunnels. The feature is available on all production SKU gateways that use standard public IPs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Code Quality is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality is now generally available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team. The announcement says it is intended to help with the growing volume of code produced with AI assistance.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Repository-level GitHub Copilot usage metrics generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot usage metrics REST API now includes repository-level activity. Two new endpoints provide a daily per-repository breakdown of pull request activity for Copilot coding agent and Copilot code review.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app now available in the usage metrics API
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot usage metrics API now includes GitHub Copilot app usage in enterprise and organization 1-day and 28-day reports. This adds admin visibility into Copilot app usage data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Customization and configurability improvements
item.description:
Copilot code review now supports a firewall, custom setup steps, and independent runner configurations. It also reads custom instructions from the head branch to make testing and validation easier.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Mobile: Fix pull request comments with Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Mobile now lets you select “Fix with Copilot” from Copilot code review pull request comments. The action is available in the pull request’s main view and uses the Copilot cloud agent.

  • Source: GitHub
